shared_elements: roughly symmetrical paired motifs about a vertical axis in the upper field
curved/linear incised bands below the upper motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carving including disc/ring shapes and roughly mirrored paired elements in an upper zone above a lower field of linear marks, but this is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A depicts an explicit scene — a winged disc over adoring human figures above dense ordered columns of sign-writing, framed as an arched stela with flanking statues — whereas B shows a rounded three-dimensional body carrying scattered curvilinear and ring motifs with a girdle-like band and no registers, no writing, and no figural adoration scene.
